en: The image is a colored, vintage-style illustration showing a well-dressed family and their dogs in front of a historical castle. The scene is pastoral and appears to be a depiction of the Baroque painter Peter Paul Rubens and his family at their estate. The castle is shown in the background, surrounded by trees and greenery. The style is reminiscent of early-to-mid 20th century printed postcards.
